Definition: something surrounding the person, i.e. a shield
BiblicalUsage: A shield is what surrounds a person, and the psalm says God's truth will be your shield and buckler. The word appears once, and it pictures protection that wraps around on every side.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's truth is not a wall in front of us but a shield around us, and that is why the psalmist can rest.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
